policy.purpose: Current-runtime descriptive SCC comparison; AKM baseline, four-core primary panel, one-way worker clustering

operational_repairs.reason: Inherited setup metadata path assumed environment.json; retained rerun uses reference-origin.json.
Linux benchmark-tooling tests exposed pending-signal cleanup precedence and inherited BASH_ENV overriding a wrapper test stub.

production_comparison_ratio_convention: Per-fit ratio is fereg/comparator; summary CSV speedup is median paired comparator/fereg.

cross_campaign_science.scope: Captured sample/discrete fields, coefficients, covariance and objective. Historical row-level saved fitted arrays are not compared; each campaign retains its own requested-output checks.

capture_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({capture, objective_metric, objective}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False). Objective is parsed as binary64.
limitations: Descriptive Linux comparison on one fixed seed and three repetitions; no confidence-qualified release or universal speed claim.
All historical counterpart configurations used different hosts. Current socket/NUMA placement also differs from the October 12 full campaign; historical timing changes do not isolate runtime effects.
Only scientifically eligible three-pair comparisons supply speed ratios; failed and ineligible observations remain visible.
Native repeat checks cover captured coordinates and objectives. Historical comparison does not compare row-level saved fitted arrays; each run retains its own requested-output checks.
Sampled process-tree RSS is not an exact allocation peak. Native phase clocks may nest and must not be summed.
The frozen c5582eb0 source is the beta.3 runtime selected at submission. Later repository and solver-reporting edits are outside this measurement.
